Name: Customize jukebox music
Author: Kiritooioo0424
Description:
[quote][b][color=#ff0000]Description[/color][/b][/quote][line]
- Add custom music to Stardew Valley jukebox; tracks display original filenames
- No fixed slots, no track quantity limits, no config file edits
- Drop genuine .ogg / .wav files into assets folder then restart game
- Recursive subfolder scan, supports multi-language Unicode filenames, auto handles duplicate names
- Jukebox list syncs with files in folder, loaded on game startup
- Standalone SMAPI mod: only .dll, manifest.json & empty assets folder.
[quote][b][color=#ff0000]Installation[/color][/b][/quote][line]
- Install SMAPI 4.0 or above
- Unzip mod folder into `Stardew Valley\Mods`
- Convert audio to real Ogg Vorbis(.ogg) or .wav; renamed MP3 files cannot play
- Put audio files into assets folder, launch game and open jukebox
- Add/remove music files then restart game
[quote][b][color=#ff0000]Main Features[/color][/b][/quote][line]
- Show raw filenames directly, no manual renaming or editing
- Unlimited tracks, recursively scan subfolders
- .ogg stream playback, follows in-game music volume setting
- Works with Better Jukebox for searchable scroll track list
[quote][b][color=#ff0000]Requirements[/color][/b][/quote][line]
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- Optional: Better Jukebox by Gaphodil
